scope: Read-only source/PDF diagnosis and prompt authoring; no app source change or project cleanup performed in this turn.

evidence.finding: Multiple global design styles imported together.
Root-level h1 size is assigned 26px then 28px.
Same root .search selector changes padding in three rules, independent of media variants.
Reference compound root-state selectors need adaptation to the product DOM, which places kind on an inner section.

interpretation: CSS architecture/selector ownership is a demonstrated issue. Tailwind-specific impact on any element requires matched/computed style inspection; removal alone is not an established cure.
recommendation: Keep Next.js; consolidate tokens/minimal base and explicit CSS Modules ownership. Audit Tailwind use before removal.
unusedFileLimit: Import-graph reachability is not proof for public assets, scripts, file conventions, dynamic class names or every execution path.
